Chabeuil.question: Chabeuil's notable town hall was designed by the architect Ernst Tracol, and was completed in _____ with tuff stone quarried in the neighbouring village of Peyrus
Chabeuil.fact: Chabeuil's notable town hall was designed by the architect Ernst Tracol, and was completed in 1883 with tuff stone quarried in the neighbouring village of Peyrus.
